description: Installation of two externally illuminated free standing signs with LED strips around edges, one illuminated aluminium tray sign, three illuminated built up lettering signs, three perforated vision signs and one illuminated LED strip around the warehouse
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission

Condition : 4 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 5 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site

Condition : 6 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Dnata City East-External Signage Drawing Rev:12 date 14/05/2019. Received: 07/06/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 7 - Illumination for the proposed illuminated signs and LED lighting strip shall be below the limit set out in the Institute of Lighting Engineer's (ILE) technical note no. 5 "The Brightness of illuminated advertisement' or at a maximum of 500cdm whichever is lower and shall be maintained as such for the life of the hereby approved signage.

Condition : 8 - The proposed signs and LED strip shall not have any intermittent light source, animation, moving feature or flash and shall be maintained as such for the life of the hereby approved signage.
